identity: Known flashed session and selected code bytes, not full flash
caveats: Latest trial only; extrema are directed margins of valid post-blank consumed samples, not a waveform or measured rotor direction.
Positioning sectors have no ADC samples by design. Max/min do not describe temporal crossing order.

Exit kinds:1 positioning dwell,2 feedback step,3 timeout retry,4 handoff,5 stopped,6 planned acquisition boundary,7 bridge release,8 re-alignment boundary. S4R alignment bins describe the first alignment only; release has no energized sector record.

alignment.caveat: Consumed sequential ADC samples in conservative ON-window; not mechanical rotor position or proof of rest.

caveats: ABI7: no launch, zero drive sectors. start0=software time after all six gate commands off; start1=CH4 high-Z sampling compare write complete.
Every consumed group for <5ms, up to512. Software readout timestamps and live/preloaded CCR snapshots, not hardware trigger timestamps.
Hi-Z flag32. Boundary flag16 marks first2 groups OR first150us; possible queued driven conversion/preload transition. These groups are retained.
Bit0 on Hi-Z groups means no second JEOS seen during reads, not analog validity. Tail bit0 retains powered alignment readout-window screen.
No group is automatically classified as pure BEMF. Later groups can still include demagnetization/clamping and release-induced motion.
Compare line differences AB/BC/CA. Releasing alignment torque can itself move the rotor; post-off voltage alone does not prove pre-off motion.
Hook maximum is selected record work, not complete IRQ cost.
